name: Itiligent Guacamole
description: A Proxmox LXC adaptation of the Itiligent Easy Guacamole Installer. It preserves the upstream Guacamole feature set and interactive choices while using Proxmox-managed container identity, networking, and firewall policy.

notes.text: The container setup is followed by the original interactive Itiligent configuration for database, authentication extensions, optional features, Nginx, and TLS.
Change the default guacadmin password immediately after the first login. Native access remains available at port 8080 unless the selected frontend configuration changes the preferred URL.
